verdicts.reason: Both just shrink the whole composition into the centre of the wider strip. The illustration clusters are squeezed toward the middle, leaving dead navy bands of about 170px on the left and right, so this is a scaled copy, not a re-laid banner. The figures are also cramped and touching the top and bottom edges. A keeps the 'CLAYTONI' / 'CREATIVE AGENCY' lockup slightly larger and easier to read at this tiny height. B shrinks the wordmark and tagline further, so the tagline is near the legibility limit and the headline has less presence against the busy artwork on both sides.
